contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਚਿੱਠੀ ਲਿਖਣੀ ਸਿੱਖੀ। (You've learned to write a letter.) This week, you'll write a letter about something real: a Punjabi festival.

New words for describing a festival: ਜਸ਼ਨ (jashan, celebration), ਇਕੱਠਾ (ikattha, gathered together), ਨੱਚਣਾ (nachna, to dance), and ਗਾਇਆ (gaya, sang, past tense). You already know ਤਿਉਹਾਰ (festival) and ਖੁਸ਼ੀ (happiness) from earlier grades. Think of a real festival you've celebrated — Vaisakhi or another — and write 2-3 sentences describing it using at least two of today's new words.
You now have real vocabulary for describing a festival in Punjabi. Tomorrow we'll learn vocabulary for describing the food that's part of these celebrations.

objectives: Learn 4 new vocabulary words for describing a festival: ਜਸ਼ਨ, ਇਕੱਠਾ, ਨੱਚਣਾ, ਗਾਇਆ
Write 2-3 sentences describing a real festival using the new vocabulary
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's letter-writing structure.
2. Introduce today's 4 new words, reviewing ਤਿਉਹਾਰ/ਖੁਸ਼ੀ from earlier grades.
3. Have the child choose a real festival and draft 2-3 descriptive sentences.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's topic: describing festival food.
differentiationTips: Struggling: allow the child to use just 1 new word correctly rather than requiring 2
Ready for more: ask them to add a sentence about how the festival made them feel, using ਖੁਸ਼ੀ
All Gurmukhi words used in this lesson were validated against gurmukhifix's Lexicon before writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: 1. ਜਸ਼ਨ = celebration. 2. ਇਕੱਠਾ = gathered together. 3. ਨੱਚਣਾ = to dance. 4. ਗਾਇਆ = sang.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Builds the cultural/festival vocabulary named in the course's 'cultural units — festivals' description, directly feeding into the week's culminating letter (Day 4).

generationData.instructions: Write the English meaning of each Gurmukhi word.
